name: Sakazaki Shouko
source: The student council adviser and also the homeroom teacher of [url=/c68296]Kouichi[/url] and [url=/c38073]Saya's[/url] class. Because of [url=/c38072]Senka's[/url] involvement and hard work she however doesn't do much work for the SC. Shouko thinks that her students should be independent, but also wants them to rely on her sometimes. As a result her classes are easy to understand and she rarely gets angry, and she is also popular with her students.
